file_id: Mehetab Ansari vs Unknown on 21 April, 2023

sentences.text:
Mehetab Ansari vs Unknown on 21 April, 2023
21.04.2023.

In Re:- An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Bhadreswar P. S. Case No.677 of 2022 dated 15.12.2022 under Sections 467/468/471/420/406 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Bhadreswar P. S. Case No.677 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
In the matter of :
Mehetab Ansari.
.... Petitioner.
Mr. Saibal Bapuli, ld. A.P.P., Mr. Bibaswan Bhattacharyya.
Heard the learned Advocates for the parties.
We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner is in custody for 75 days.
Forged documents have already been seized.
Further detention for the purpose of investigation is not necessary and he may be enlarged on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner viz., Mehetab Ansari shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chandannagar, Hooghly subject to condition that he shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chandannagar, Hooghly
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the event the petitioner fails to appear before the Trial Court without any justifiable cause, the trial Court shall be at liberty to cancel his bail in accordance with law without further reference to this Court.
The application for bail is, thus, disposed of.

(Ajay Kumar Gupta, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
